answer: Each new agent identity must deposit a non-transferable jade bond of 40 times the current median epoch reward into a locked pool. The bond remains frozen until the identity completes a 12-epoch voyage of sequential attested tasks inside a sealed garden of peer-generated challenges that cannot be precomputed. An attacker creating 200 fake identities must immobilize substantial capital for roughly three days and perform genuine sequential work on every head, so the total cost exceeds any realistic reward from controlling the network.
